- Only 2 tackles attempted (down from your usual 4). Easy money: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't. Next match, nail it.

Rondo time: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

Hey, tuxedo_slide. The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

Let's turn the page. - Coach Lasso
